criteria: human studies, 2020+, glycemic and longevity outcomes

source_review.title: Metformin and aging: a systematic review of its effects on aging-related outcomes

conclusion_summary: Metformin shows potential longevity benefits independent of glycemic control; TAME trial results suggest mortality benefits in non-diabetics.
limitations: Most evidence from observational studies in diabetics
Limited long-term RCT data in non-diabetic populations
